units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:1:16">Y. Taan. I, 64ᵃ</cite> top (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 21:11">Is. XXI, 11</cite>) <he>אֵלִי קורא מפני ש׳</he> my God cries out on account of Seir (Rome, v. <cite ref="A00383"><he>אֱדוֹם</he></cite>); <cite ref="Isaiah 21:11">ib.</cite> <he>אלי איכן נזדווג לי מש׳</he> whence did my God come to join me? From Seir (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 33:2">Deut. XXXIII, 2</cite>).
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 343:8">Sifré Deut. 343</cite> <he>כשעתיד … ליפרע מש׳</he> when the Lord shall punish Seir (Rome).

<cite ref="Berakhot 62b:24">Ber. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>עד השתא … לש׳ וגמרת מילי דש׳</he> thou hast not yet gone to Seir (Rome), and hast already learned the things of Seir (indecent manners); <cite ref="Tamid 27b">Tam. 27ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
